DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2014_family.do infixes DA3032 at the ES3032 DATA LIST positions (P21D01..P21D12 = cols 200-211, identical to ES3032 lines 18-19 and to the questionnaire's column codes (200)-(211)) under lower-cased names, and Bookmark 10 sets item = the variable name (p21d01..p21d12; lower-casing is Stata naming) -- nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt and no verification_/verify_ files were written. LABELS vs QUESTIONNAIRE: ES3032 VARIABLE LABELS P21D01-P21D12 match the P.21d grid rows in cues3032.pdf character for character, 12/12 (read from a 300-dpi render of scanned page 6, not OCR; the questionnaire's hyphenated line breaks 'opi-/nión', 'religio-/sos', 'ta-/tuajes' rejoined; the '.' after 'gastos' on the printed P21D01 row runs into the dot leaders and is not in the label, so it is not shipped); item_text is the variable label verbatim (12/12 string-identical, checked in build.R). VALUE LABELS identical on all 12: 0 'N.P.' 1 'Un problema grave' 2 'Un problema leve' 3 'No es un problema' 9 'N.C.' -- codes 1-3 match the questionnaire's printed column heads ('Un proble-/ma grave', 'Un proble-/ma leve', 'No es un/problema', rejoined), and the value-label spelling is what ships. RESP BY DESIGN: the .do recodes 0 (N.P., not asked) and 9 (N.C.) to missing, so live resp is {1..3} and option rows ship for those three codes only. Dropped by the .do: code 0 1976 on every item; code 9 per item p21d01..p21d12 = 12/10/10/12/16/11/10/10/13/11/11/11 (DA3032 carries no other codes); 10 of the 488 asked respondents answered N.C. to all twelve and so have no rows, which is why live has 478 ids. FILTER: P.21d is asked only 'A QUIENES CONVIVEN CON HIJOS/AS DE 12 A 25 AÑOS (Ver respuesta P.21c)'; DA3032 confirms it exactly -- a record has a P21D01 code 1-9 if and only if at least one of P21C01-P21C03 (cols 194-199, ages of cohabiting children) lies in 12..25 (488 of 2464; 0 exceptions in either direction). The routing header is interviewer text and is not shipped; the public_note carries the population. CHECKED, decisive: reading DA3032 (2464 records, all 385 bytes; id = row number) at cols 200-211, dropping 0/9 as the .do does, with cov_sex col 254 and cov_age cols 255-256 (99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 5719 rows both, 478 ids both, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt rows, 0 resp and 0 cov_age mismatches; cov_sex stored as the Stata value label (Hombre 2737 rows, Mujer 2982, no cross cells). Live item x resp (1/2/3): p21d01 16/125/335, p21d02 26/140/312, p21d03 19/89/370, p21d04 30/112/334, p21d05 1/52/419, p21d06 53/142/282, p21d07 5/56/417, p21d08 53/218/207, p21d09 1/35/439, p21d10 14/58/405, p21d11 50/188/239, p21d12 66/206/205 -- every item uses all three levels; help with housework (p21d08, mean 2.3) and screen time (p21d12, 2.3) are the most-reported problems and political/religious differences (p21d05, p21d09, 2.9) the least, as the content predicts. validate_items.R --table-sets passed (12 items, resp {1..3}). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the P.21d stem verbatim from cues3032.pdf ('Voy a leerle ...'), shared by all twelve rows, so instructions not section_prompt, one trivial section; the question carries no interviewer direction to drop. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3032 in Spanish only; the _translated columns are English written by this project ('Las horas de regreso a casa' rendered 'The times they come home') -- issues-page line owed at upload. RIGHTS: instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, 2026-09-22, every CIS survey year) applied, not re-derived. Not an instrument-name mismatch: the dictionary description (seriousness of twelve issues with the children the respondent lives with) matches the twelve P.21d rows. Not confused with sibling _activities (Bookmark 11, P.21g), a different question block.
